messages.subject: dplyr: group transform problem
parts:
Hi all,

Thanks for the great work on ddply and dplyr. I'm seeing some strange and inconsistent behavior when applying transforms with ddply and dplyr. For example, I would expect the function ``f`` to subtract the group-wise maximum from every value in that group. Instead, dplyr (0.1.3) subtracts the full-data max to every value in the set. ``ddply`` works as expected.

Any thoughts?

Vincent

library(plyr)
library(dplyr)
df = data.frame('a'=gl(10, 10), 'b'=rnorm(100))

f = function(x) x - max(x)
k = ddply(df, 'a', transform, ddply = f(b))
k$bad = k$b - max(k$b)
k$good = unlist(tapply(df$b, df$a, function(i) i - max(i)))
l = df %.% group_by(b) %.% transform(dplyr = f(b))

res = merge(k, l)

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: dplyr: group transform problem
parts:
You need to use mutate, not transform in dplyr.
Hadley
